description: WTGs are to be spaced in a 0.93 by 0.75 nautical mile offset grid pattern.
context_quote: Dominion would space WTGs in a 0.93- by 0.75-nautical-mile offset grid pattern (east–west by northwest by southeast gridded layout).

description: Micrositing of WTGs is allowed up to 500 feet.
context_quote: This configuration would still allow micrositing of WTGs (up to 500 feet) to avoid sensitive cultural resources and marine habitats.

description: 8 WTGs and associated infrastructure are excluded from the Fish Haven area.
context_quote: However, under Alternative B, the Fish Haven area located along the northern boundary of the Lease Area would be an exclusion zone (e.g., eight WTGs and associated infrastructure would not be developed or placed in the Fish Haven area).

description: 3 WTGs and associated cables are excluded from the northwest corner of the Lease Area.
geographic_scope: Northwest corner of the Lease Area
context_quote: Additionally, three WTGs and associated inter-array cables would be excluded from the northwest corner of the Lease Area to avoid a proposed vessel traffic fairway.

description: 4 WTGs are to be removed within priority sand ridge habitat.
context_quote: However, in addition to avoiding the Fish Haven area and proposed vessel traffic fairway, Alternative C would also avoid sand ridge habitat by a combination of: micrositing WTGs, inter-array cables or OSSs (up to 500 feet); the removal of four WTGs within priority sand ridge habitat, and the relocation of one WTG.

description: 1 WTG is to be relocated to minimize impacts on sand ridge habitat.
context_quote: the removal of four WTGs within priority sand ridge habitat, and the relocation of one WTG.

description: The three OSSs would be placed within the rows of the gridded WTG layout.
context_quote: The three OSSs would be placed within the rows of the gridded WTG layout.

description: Cable protection is expected where the OEC crosses existing telecommunications cables.
geographic_scope: Where OEC crosses existing telecommunications cables
context_quote: Cable protection is currently expected where the OEC crosses existing telecommunications cables.

description: Avoid the use of plastics/recycled polyesters/net material for scour and cable protection.
context_quote: The Lessee must avoid the use of plastics/recycled polyesters/net material (i.e., fronded mattresses), as technically and/or economically feasible or practicable.

description: Scour and cable protection materials must consist of natural or engineered stone.
context_quote: The Lessee must ensure that all materials used for scour and cable protection measures consist of natural or engineered stone that does not inhibit epibenthic growth and provides three- dimensional complexity in height and in interstitial spaces, as technically and/or economically feasible or practicable.

description: Cable protection measures should have tapered or sloped edges.
context_quote: Cable protection measures should have tapered or sloped edges to reduce hangs for mobile fishing gear.

description: Bubble curtains must be used during pile driving.
context_quote: The Lessee must use a bubble curtain during all impact pile driving activities.

description: Minimum of four visual PSOs must be actively observing for marine mammals and sea turtles before, during, and after pile driving.
context_quote: At minimum, four visual PSOs must be actively observing for marine mammals and sea turtles before, during, and after pile driving.

description: At least two visual PSOs must be stationed on the pile driving vessel.
context_quote: At least two visual PSOs must be stationed on the pile driving vessel and at least two visual PSOs must be stationed on a secondary, PSO-dedicated vessel.

description: At least two visual PSOs must be stationed on a secondary, PSO-dedicated vessel positioned approximately 3 km from the pile being driven.
geographic_scope: On PSO-dedicated vessel approximately 3 km from pile being driven
context_quote: At least two visual PSOs must be stationed on a secondary, PSO-dedicated vessel. The dedicated PSO vessel must be positioned approximately 3 km from the pile being driven and circle the pile at a speed of less than 10 kts.

description: The dedicated PSO vessel must circle the pile at a speed of less than 10 kts.
context_quote: The dedicated PSO vessel must be positioned approximately 3 km from the pile being driven and circle the pile at a speed of less than 10 kts.

description: Clearance and shutdown zones must be used during pile driving activities.
context_quote: The Lessee must use visual PSOs and PAM operators to monitor the area around each foundation pile before, during, and after pile driving. The clearance and shutdown zones are defined below.

description: WTG locations, OSS locations, inter-array, and export cable routes will be microsited to avoid or minimize impacts to steep slopes with gradients greater than or equal to 10 degrees, complex habitat, boulders greater than or equal to 0.5 meters in diameter and confirmed MEC/UXO.
context_quote: The Lessee must prepare and implement a Micrositing Plan that describes how WTG locations, OSS locations, inter-array, and export cable routes will be microsited to avoid or minimize impacts to steep slopes with gradients greater than or equal to 10 degrees, complex habitat, boulders greater than or equal to 0.5 meters in diameter and confirmed MEC/UXO.

description: The Lessee must not microsite structure locations in a way that narrows any WTG corridors to less than the distance required by Section 3.1.3.
context_quote: The Lessee must not microsite structure locations in a way that narrows any WTG corridors to less than the distance required by Section 3.1.3.

description: Clearance and shutdown zones must be established and monitored during HRG surveys.
context_quote: PSOs must establish and monitor the clearance and shutdown zones described below. These zones must be based on the radial distance from the acoustic source and not from the vessel.
